text: When the calculated reservoir volume reaches the empty threshold during an infusion, the pump shall issue an Empty Reservoir alarm within 1 second.

source.ref: GPCA Safety Requirements (Jetley & Jones 2007), as cited in UPenn PRECISE GPCA materials, SR 1.5.6
source.note: Paraphrase. Source threshold 'y ml' modeled as signal reservoir_empty; 'during infusion' as mode NORMAL; the 1 s deadline is ours (source gives none).
